paper.title: DSTAR: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers via Spatial and Temporal Redundancy Reduction

dit-xl2-512.source: DiT-XL-512, 50 steps. Fig. 14 labeled 56% below INT8; Fig. 15 visually digitized, approximately 0.67 retained work. DSTAR inputs and accuracy protocol differ.

flux1-dev.source: FLUX.1-dev-1k. Fig. 14 labeled 40% below INT8; Fig. 15 approximately 0.59. DSTAR uses 28 steps versus HARP workload's 50.

latte-1.source: Latte. Section 5.2 reports 3.2 average bits; Fig. 15 approximately 0.71. DSTAR uses 50 steps; HARP's proxy uses 100 steps and a different hidden width.

sd3-medium.source: SD3.5-Medium substituted for HARP's SD3 Medium. Fig. 14 labeled 49% below INT8; Fig. 15 approximately 0.50.

wan21-14b-81f.source: Wan absent from DSTAR evaluation. Scenario transfers paper-wide 4.3-bit average and up-to-50% attention reduction; no model-specific observation.

opensora-v13.source: Open-Sora absent from DSTAR evaluation. Scenario transfers paper-wide 4.3-bit average and up-to-50% attention reduction; no model-specific observation.
